fixes.explanation: Right, baker! His brothers say, "Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing." (John 7:3) The disciples in Judea are the ones they name. I think the brothers sound like folks pushing a friend to post the big news already. Funny thing is, the very next verse says even His own brothers did not believe in Him. (John 7:5)

The chief priests are big names in the Gospels, but the brothers don't name them here. They say they want "…Your disciples there…" to see the works. (John 7:3) The priests didn't make this guest list, baker. I've been left off a guest list or two myself, and it still stings a little.
